appearance_preferences.native_behavior_modeled: Sketcher caches its current edit color and uses that as fallback when an unsigned color preference is removed.

manual_observations: Solid canvas has light background, grouped Browser, top document tabs, compact timeline and bottom navigation.
Idle Solid canvas right-click opens the eight-tool radial palette.
Double-clicking a Browser sketch opens the contextual ribbon and right-hand Sketch Palette.
Dark sketch edges remain readable on the light canvas; native dimensional annotations remain visible.
Finish Sketch returns to the Solid ribbon and closes the native task palette.
provenance: After the full installed restart, a sketch-contrast follow-up was installed/reloaded. All final 28/27/30 GUI suites were rerun against that installed source. Startup entry scripts are unchanged by the contrast follow-up. A final cleanup hardening primes native Sketcher color defaults before removing previously absent preferences; its two focused Python lifecycle regressions pass. The 85 GUI suites preceded that deactivation-only hardening.
platform_limits: No Windows, macOS, Qt6 or FreeCAD 1.1 execution was performed in this session.
remaining_limits: Advanced tools retain native FreeCAD task behavior.
Radial tools are click-to-activate in idle Solid; active tasks and sketch drawing retain native context/cancel behavior.
Timeline stepping uses Body Tips and starts at the first solid. Full history reordering is not implemented.
Construction grid is fixed at 10 mm and is presentation only.
Complete Fusion feature parity and full application distribution remain future work.
